task: Hb regression from source-linked numeric g/dL targets
status: Full-hand-trained scratch CNN embeddings; exploratory due to n=250 and one held-out split
cnn_feature_source: Member 4 compact FullHandScratchCNN trained from random initialization on Full-hand training participants only
cnn_architecture: 4 compact ConvBlock stages with channels 24/48/96/128, global average pooling, 64-D projection, dropout 0.4, linear Hb head

cnn_training_provenance.experiment: Full-hand Hb CNN trained from scratch; separate from Member 3 checkpoints
cnn_training_provenance.architecture: 4 compact ConvBlock stages with channels 24/48/96/128, global average pooling, 64-D projection, dropout 0.4, linear Hb head
cnn_training_provenance.image_preprocessing: RGB; Pillow bilinear resize 224x224; float32 /255; ImageNet mean/std normalization; train-only horizontal flip and brightness factor 0.9-1.1

training.selection: minimum validation MAE; model weights fit only on training participants

cnn_training_provenance.target_source: Source-linked numeric Figshare Hb g/dL from the supplied participant split table; no folder-derived class labels used

target_source: Source-linked numeric Figshare Hb g/dL; no folder-derived anemia label used
limitations: Only 175 training, 37 validation and 38 test participants are available; performance is highly uncertain and is not clinical validation.
CNN checkpoint selection used validation MAE; XGBoost selection used validation MAE; test participants were not used for either choice.
CNN was trained from scratch with no pretrained weights. Results are seed- and split-specific.
No multimodal fusion or clinical deployment is claimed.
